title: Running Commentary on Torah 26 — Retzitza d'Meis b'Bi'uso
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 26 — רציצא דמית בביעותיה
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: The Athenians asked: **'retzitza d'meis b'bi'uso, heicha nafak rucha?'** — 'A chick that died in its egg — from where did its spirit depart?' He said to them: **'b'hinu d'al'** — 'from where it entered.'

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b**: chick died in its egg — from where did the ruach exit? Answer: **"b'hinu d'al"** — from where it entered.
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח:**: אפרוח שמת בביצה — מהיכן יצא הרוח? תשובה: **"בהינו דעאל"** — ממקום שנכנס.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **retzitza d'meis** = a chick that died inside its eggshell.

intermediate.en: Rashi: retzitza d'meis=chick died in shell.

beginner.en: **The Rebbe's peirush (brief)**: **Retzitza = efroach = tzaddik** ("yifrach b'yamav tzaddik," Tehillim 72:7). They asked: a tzaddik who **mortifies himself and moser nefesh in tzloso u'v'uso** (tefilah) — in **which part of the tefilah** does he need to be most moser nefesh? Answer: **'heicha d'al'** — where he must raise **nitzotzei ha'kedushah** — i.e., how **machshavos zaros enter** him, and he must raise them up (as known) — that is where his moser-nefesh applies.

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: retzitza=efroach=tzaddik (Teh 72:7 "yifrach tzaddik"). Q: tzaddik moser nefesh in tefilah — where most? A: **"b'hinu d'al"**=at the point where **machshavos zaros enter** (raise them).
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: רציצא=אפרוח=צדיק (תה' עב, ז "יפרח צדיק"). שאלה: צדיק מוסר נפש בתפילה — היכן הכי? תשובה: **"בהינו דעאל"**=במקום ש**מחשבות זרות נכנסות** (להעלותן).

scholarly.he: סעיף א. אפרוח=צדיק (תה' עב, ז); מחשבות זרות.
